name: pencil-viewer-promo
description: Pencil Viewer の紹介動画 (Remotion) と はてなブログ用の紹介記事

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Intro out/pencil-viewer-intro.mp4 --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --timeout=180000 --concurrency=4
scripts.render:gif: remotion render src/index.ts IntroShort out/pencil-viewer-intro.gif --codec=gif --scale=0.5 --every-nth-frame=2 --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --timeout=180000 --concurrency=4
scripts.still: remotion still src/index.ts Intro out/still.png --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --timeout=180000
